# fido — FIDO security keys

[All groups](README.md)

## fido devices

List the FIDO security keys connected over USB: path, vendor and product, CTAPHID version and capabilities (CTAP2, U2F, wink), supported CTAP versions and AAGUID. wink makes each key blink to tell them apart.

MCP tool: `fido_devices`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--wink` | bool | Make each key blink (CTAPHID_WINK). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## fido info

Ask a connected FIDO security key about itself (CTAP2 authenticatorGetInfo): CTAP versions, AAGUID, options explained (PIN set, discoverable credentials, built-in user verification, credential management, enterprise attestation), algorithms, extensions, firmware version, PIN length rules and free passkey slots. Needs no touch.

MCP tool: `fido_info`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--device` | string | Which key: index or path from fido.devices (default: the only one connected). |
| `--metadata` | bool | Also look the model up in the FIDO Metadata Service (certification, security status). |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## fido metadata

Look an authenticator model up in the FIDO Metadata Service (MDS3): by AAGUID, U2F attestation key ID, attestation certificate, or a search on the description. Reports the model, its certification level, security status (revoked, compromised attestation or user keys, UV bypass), attestation types and roots, and checks a given attestation certificate against those roots. The BLOB (about 11 MB) is downloaded from mds3.fidoalliance.org, verified (signature, chain to the FIDO MDS root, CRLs) and cached until its next update.

MCP tool: `fido_metadata`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--aaguid` | string | AAGUID to look up (FIDO2 authenticators). |
| `--key-identifier` | string | Attestation certificate key ID, hex SHA-1 of its public key (U2F authenticators). |
| `--attestation-certificate` | string | An attestation certificate (PEM or base64 DER): looked up by its AAGUID extension or key ID, and its chain checked. CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--search` | string | List models whose description contains this text. |
| `--refresh` | bool | Download the BLOB even if the cached one is current. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
